senses.gloss: m. (χολικός, in the sense of μελαγχολικός) one afflicted with melancholy.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1:11">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ</cite> <he>המקרע את כסותו כ׳</he> if one tears his clothes, I may say, he is melancholy (but not insane); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:2">Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48ᶜ</cite> <he>המקרע … קינוקוס</he> (corr. acc.).
